rendering.notes: Pixel art stays crisp with nearest filtering and no MSAA; resolution caps at min(devicePixelRatio, 2). The camera zooms so ~520 world px fill the window height.

layers.notes: World-space order is level tiles, ground (telegraphs, glows), actors (depth-sorted), effects, overlay (projectiles, bars), then screen-space darkness and hurt flash.

postProcessing.notes: No GPU post chain: vignette/darkness breathing, low-HP pulse and hurt flash are drawn in canvas in Renderer/ActorView. Shader files under assets/shaders are reserved, not loaded.

particles.notes: CPU-pooled sprites in Effects.ts; ambient mote budget is 32-48 per biome in atmosphere.ts.
